CustomField.description: System flag used to bypass the 'Prevent_Manual_Active_Status' validation rule. This checkbox is set to True by the Approval Process Final Approval Actions to allow the Status to change to 'Active' and is immediately reset to False by a Record-Triggered Flow to re-secure the record from manual edits.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Do not add to page layouts. This is a hidden system field used by the Approval Process.
CustomField.label: Update Via Approval
